title: erythranthe × robertsii
intro: Erythranthe × robertsii, commonly known as Western Pennyroyal, is a hybrid plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Erythranthe × robertsii include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory conditions, and act as a natural insect repellent. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include essential oils such as menthone, limonene, and pulegone, although care should be taken due to potential toxicity from the last compound.
